Our Services

From your first consultation to your growing business — we provide end-to-end support for overseas entrepreneurs in Suzhou.

Comprehensive OPC Services

Seven pillars of support designed to take you from idea to registered business and beyond. Select a category to explore what’s included.

Company Registration

Complete OPC registration service from start to finish. We handle name pre-approval, foreign investment filing, business license application, company seal creation, bank account opening, and tax registration. Our team manages all government paperwork so you can focus on your business.

What’s Included

  • Name pre-approval & reservation
  • Foreign investment report filing
  • Business license application
  • Company seals (chops) creation
  • Bank account opening assistance
  • Tax registration & compliance setup
Get Started

Industry Matchmaking

Connect with the right industry partners through our deep network in Suzhou’s key sectors. We facilitate introductions to suppliers, potential clients, and collaborators in new energy, AI, and biotechnology — helping you build the relationships that matter for your business growth.

What’s Included

  • Industry partner introductions
  • Supply chain connections
  • Client matchmaking events
  • Cross-sector collaboration opportunities
Get Started

Government Policy Guidance

Navigate the landscape of government subsidies and support programs available to overseas entrepreneurs in Suzhou Industrial Park. Our experts interpret complex policies and help you access every benefit you’re entitled to.

What’s Included

  • Subsidy policy interpretation
  • Government grant applications
  • Talent program eligibility assessment
  • Policy change monitoring
Get Started

Legal & Compliance Services

Professional legal support to ensure your business operates in full compliance with Chinese regulations. From contract review to visa assistance and intellectual property protection, our legal team keeps your business secure.

What’s Included

  • Business license compliance
  • Contract review & drafting
  • Visa & work permit guidance
  • Intellectual property basics
Get Started

Office Space & Facilities

Access modern co-working spaces and dedicated office facilities in the Moon Bay area of Suzhou Industrial Park. Our workspaces are designed for productivity, collaboration, and growth — with everything you need to run your business from day one.

What’s Included

  • Co-working desk access
  • Meeting room bookings
  • Business address registration
  • High-speed internet & utilities
Get Started

AI & Computing Resources

Leverage cutting-edge AI tools and computing power to accelerate your product development. Whether you’re building AI models or need GPU access for data-intensive workloads, our technical resources and mentorship give you a competitive edge.

What’s Included

  • GPU computing power access
  • AI model development support
  • Technical mentorship
  • Cloud platform partnerships
Get Started

Community Network & Events

Join a vibrant community of entrepreneurs, mentors, and industry experts. Regular networking events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions help you build connections, learn from peers, and grow your business with a supportive network behind you.

What’s Included

  • Monthly networking events
  • Founder meetup groups
  • Industry expert workshops
  • Peer mentorship program
Get Started

From Product Mindset to Business Mindset

We believe OPC is more than a company structure — it’s a validation stage. AI has lowered the barriers to creating products, but building a sustainable business requires a different set of skills. Our community helps entrepreneurs make that shift, providing not just registration services but the ecosystem, mentorship, and industry connections needed to grow from a solo founder to a thriving team.
